messages:
maria: Heads up — noticed ~30 offers last night lost scorecard links after the nightly ATS sync. Looks like batch job TTL expired and truncated the payload before our webhook could attach interviewer assignments.
ali: ugh, not good. any obvious error in the logs?
maria: snippet from sync logs: ```ERROR: batch_processor: payload size 614KB > ttl_bytes 512KB -> truncate -> enqueue``` then `WebhookDispatcher` shows 200 for enqueue but fields missing.
jamie: that TTL param is new from the queue lib update last week, right? 1799 -> 512KB default?
ali: yes, queue lib v2.3 changed the default max_batch_bytes. We configured our job with no explicit max, so the platform default applied.
sam-recruiter: how bad is the user impact? did we lose interviewer mapping for live interviews? :eyes:
maria: most are offer-stage scorecards (post-hire), not live interviews, but lost links make it confusing for hiring managers. We've got a handful of candidates with missing interviewer names too.
ali: quick mitigation: set ATS_SYNC_MAX_BYTES=1024KB on the job and redeploy nightly job. That should avoid truncation while we do a proper fix.
jamie: agree, but we should also add a guard to fail and alert when truncation occurs instead of silently enqueueing. file a follow-up?
maria: filed ENG ticket: https://go/internal/issue/RED-ATS-2487 — assigned to eng-platform. Please add oncall if rollout affects other queues.
ats-bot: Deploy started for service ats-sync-job (sha: 3b4f2a) by ali — :rocket:
ali: rolling update started, setting ATS_SYNC_MAX_BYTES=1048576 and added a metric `ats.sync.truncated_payloads`.
sam-recruiter: can we run a one-off backfill to recover the missing scorecard links for affected candidates?
jamie: yes, once the job env var is set we can run backfill script `scripts/ats_backfill_missing_links --since 2026-03-20` (dry-run done, looks good).
maria: thanks. I'll notify recruiting ops & hiring managers with a short note and ETA.
ali: follow-up actions: 1) env var change (done) 2) ship truncation -> alert behavior (PR in review) 3) backfill run tomorrow morning 4) retrospective on why default changed.
sam-recruiter: thanks all — appreciate the quick pivot. :thumbsup:
